Customer addresses: Another import is running. Only one import runs at a time.
Kundeadresser: En annen import kjører. Bare én import kan kjøre om gangen.

Customer addresses: There is another unfinished import of this type. Close it first.
Kundeadresser: Det finnes en annen uferdig import av denne typen. Lukk den først.

Customer addresses: The file still has errors. Fix them and check again.
Kundeadresser: Filen har fortsatt feil. Rett dem og kontroller på nytt.

Customer addresses: The import is not in a state where this can be done. The page shows its current state.
Kundeadresser: Importen er ikke i en tilstand der dette kan gjøres. Siden viser den aktuelle tilstanden.

Customer addresses: There is no file with errors to download for this import.
Kundeadresser: Det finnes ingen fil med feil å laste ned for denne importen.

Customer addresses: The page could not reach the server. Try again.
Kundeadresser: Siden fikk ikke kontakt med serveren. Prøv igjen.

Customer addresses: A ${what} import is running. Start this one when it finishes.
Kundeadresser: En import (${what}) kjører. Start denne når den er ferdig.

Customer addresses: There is another ${what} import that is not finished. Close it before you resume this one.
Kundeadresser: Det finnes en annen uferdig import (${what}). Lukk den før du fortsetter med denne.

Customer addresses: Canceling: the import stops after the row it is working on.
Kundeadresser: Avbryter: importen stopper etter raden den jobber med.

Customer addresses: The import has not started yet. If this stays, the store's background process may not be running.
Kundeadresser: Importen har ikke startet ennå. Hvis det vedvarer, kjører kanskje butikkens bakgrunnsprosess ikke.

Customer addresses: Slowing down so the store stays fast...
Kundeadresser: Går saktere slik at butikken holder seg rask...

Customer addresses: This check ran while a ${what} import was running. Check again when it has finished.
Kundeadresser: Denne kontrollen ble kjørt mens en import (${what}) pågikk. Kontroller på nytt når den er ferdig.

Customer addresses: The file was checked again when the import was about to start, and new problems were found.
Kundeadresser: Filen ble kontrollert på nytt rett før importen skulle starte, og det ble funnet nye problemer.

Customer addresses: Page addresses are finished in the background and may take a few minutes. ${count} were rebuilt after the import.
Kundeadresser: Sideadresser ferdigstilles i bakgrunnen og kan ta noen minutter. ${count} ble gjenopprettet etter importen.

Customer addresses: Page addresses are finished in the background and may take a few minutes.
Kundeadresser: Sideadresser ferdigstilles i bakgrunnen og kan ta noen minutter.

Customer addresses: The file is still being uploaded. If the upload stops, it is deleted after 10 minutes.
Kundeadresser: Filen lastes fortsatt opp. Hvis opplastingen stopper, slettes den etter 10 minutter.

Customer addresses: Waiting for the check to start...
Checking the rows against the store...
You can leave this page. The check continues on the server.
Kundeadresser: Du kan forlate denne siden. Kontrollen fortsetter på serveren.

Customer addresses: The check found ${errors} errors and ${warnings} warnings in ${total} rows.
Kundeadresser: Kontrollen fant ${errors} feil og ${warnings} advarsler i ${total} rader.

Customer addresses: Fix them to continue: the import starts only on a clean file.
Kundeadresser: Rett dem for å fortsette: importen starter bare med en feilfri fil.

Customer addresses: All ${total} rows are valid: ${create} to create, ${update} to update, ${warnings} warnings.
Kundeadresser: Alle ${total} radene er gyldige: ${create} som opprettes, ${update} som oppdateres, ${warnings} advarsler.

Customer addresses: Checking the file again before the import...
Kundeadresser: Kontrollerer filen på nytt før importen...

Customer addresses: If new problems are found, nothing is written.
Kundeadresser: Hvis det blir funnet nye problemer, skrives ingenting.

Customer addresses: Stopped after ${failed} failed rows (${done} of ${total} rows done).
Kundeadresser: Stoppet etter ${failed} mislykkede rader (${done} av ${total} rader ferdig).

Customer addresses: Fix the cause, then resume: the failed rows are tried again and the import continues.
Kundeadresser: Rett årsaken og gjenoppta: de mislykkede radene prøves på nytt, og importen fortsetter.

Customer addresses: The import stopped before it finished. ${done} rows were done.
Kundeadresser: Importen stoppet før den ble ferdig. ${done} rader ble behandlet.

Customer addresses: Resume continues at the last saved row.
Kundeadresser: Gjenopptakelse fortsetter fra siste lagrede rad.

Customer addresses: The page could not reach the server. It shows the last state it knew and will try again.
Kundeadresser: Siden fikk ikke kontakt med serveren. Den viser siste kjente tilstand og prøver igjen.

Customer addresses: There is no problem to display.
More problems exist than are listed.
Kundeadresser: Det finnes flere problemer enn de som er listet.

Customer addresses: The file and the list of problems are deleted. The rows already imported stay in the store.
Kundeadresser: Filen og problemlisten slettes. Rader som allerede er importert, blir værende i butikken.

Customer addresses: The import stops after the row it is working on. The rows already imported stay in the store.
Kundeadresser: Importen stopper etter raden den jobber med. Rader som allerede er importert, blir værende i butikken.
